name: tinto-rooming-lists
description: Producing a per-tour rooming list with passport details, matching Tinto's real rooming-list format: room/guest/bed-configuration summary plus per-guest passport data, delivered as a two-tab workbook (English and the hotel's own local language). A standalone plugin, open to anyone on the team who needs it. Rebuilt 2026-09-15 against a real reference template and live production schema.
